stations.title: Loose variables
stations.text: Four values per repair, kept apart by name.

stations.title: Customer
stations.say: Yes, that mantel clock is mine.

captions: Dorrit holds ticket 3101 and needs to know whose clock it is.
Each repair is four loose variables, and they drift apart.
You write a struct that keeps a whole repair as one value.
Now ticket 3101 carries its owner, its item and its minutes with it.
Each repair is one value now. Next, Kasimir hands repairs to functions.
